name: asm-polycall
assembler: GNU-compatible assembler via the C compiler (gcc or clang)

architectures.x86_64-win64: runtime-tested (MSYS2 UCRT64; UCRT64 and MSVC core DLLs)
architectures.aarch64: runtime-tested on Linux under qemu-user emulation; Mach-O and Windows COFF assemble, not runtime-tested
architectures.x86: runtime-tested on Linux (ELF PIC, native i386) and Windows (COFF, WoW64); Mach-O assembles, not runtime-tested
architectures.arm: runtime-tested on Linux armhf under qemu-user emulation

author: Nnamdi Michael Okpala <okpalan@protonmail.com>
